parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
d AS (
  SELECT dd.document_id, dd.content_hash FROM jarvis_privat.document dd, p
  WHERE (p.j->>'ok')::boolean AND dd.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND dd.context_id = 'privat'
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.document_text AS t (document_id, context_id, content_hash, page_count, text_character_count, mean_confidence, detected_language, provider_job_id, full_text, pages, extracted_at)
  SELECT d.document_id, 'privat', d.content_hash, coalesce((p.j->>'page_count')::int, 0), char_length(p.j->>'full_text'), (p.j->>'mean_confidence')::numeric,
         nullif(p.j->>'sprache', ''), p.j->>'provider', coalesce(p.j->>'full_text', ''), coalesce(p.j->'pages', '[]'::jsonb), now()
  FROM d, p
  ON CONFLICT (document_id) DO UPDATE SET content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, page_count = EXCLUDED.page_count, text_character_count = EXCLUDED.text_character_count,
    mean_confidence = EXCLUDED.mean_confidence, detected_language = EXCLUDED.detected_language, provider_job_id = EXCLUDED.provider_job_id,
    full_text = EXCLUDED.full_text, pages = EXCLUDED.pages, extracted_at = now()
  WHERE t.full_text IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.full_text OR t.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content_hash
  RETURNING t.document_id, (xmax = 0) AS neu
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_text_extracted', 'jarvis', 'Volltext erfasst: ' || up.document_id,
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', up.document_id, 'seiten', (p.j->>'page_count')::int, 'zeichen', char_length(p.j->>'full_text'), 'konfidenz', p.j->'mean_confidence',
      'quelle', p.j->>'quelle', 'neu', up.neu, 'change_request', 'CR-12')
  FROM up, p
  RETURNING log_id
),
f AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_text_failed', 'jarvis', 'Volltext nicht erfasst: ' || coalesce(p.j->>'document_id', '?'),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'fehler', left(p.j->>'fehler', 300), 'quelle', p.j->>'quelle', 'change_request', 'CR-12')
  FROM p WHERE NOT coalesce((p.j->>'ok')::boolean, false)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM up)::int AS gespeichert, (SELECT count(*) FROM d)::int AS dokument_gefunden, ((SELECT count(*) FROM l) + (SELECT count(*) FROM f))::int AS protokolliert
